formulas.K1_0_bulk_alternative: 1 (t->0+ at fixed distance first, then r->0)
formulas.factor_definition: N=N_plus*N_minus; N_plus and inverse analytic in Im(xi)>0; N_minus and inverse analytic in Im(xi)<0; N_plus(infinity)=N_minus(infinity)=I; square roots have positive real part
formulas.factor_kernel: k=abs(xi); m=sqrt(1+xi^2); t=k/(m+k); D=1+eta-2*eta*k*t/m; k_plus=sqrt(-i*xi); k_minus=sqrt(i*xi); m_plus=sqrt(1-i*xi); m_minus=sqrt(1+i*xi); N=[[D,sqrt(2*eta)*t/(m_plus*k_plus)],[sqrt(2*eta)*t/(m_minus*k_minus),1]]; N(0)=diag(1+eta,1)
formulas.p_faces_0: 2*d/a (undrained outer-limit pressure); actual prescribed face trace is 0
